In the middle circle, write first the name of the hour in which you perform the work, in the second place the name of the Angel of the hour, and in the third the seal of the Angel of the hour. Fourth, the name of the Angel who presides over the day in which you perform the work and his ministers. Fifth, the name of the present time. Sixth, the name of the Spirits reigning in that part of the time and presiding over it. Seventh, the name of the head of the sign reigning in that part of the time in which you perform the work. Eighth, the name of the Earth, according to that part of the time in which you perform the work. Ninth, and for the completion of the middle circle, write the names of the Sun and the Moon, according to the aforesaid calculation of time. For when the Time is changed, the names change also. In the upper circle, however, let there be assigned in the four angles the names of the angels presiding over the air on the day in which you perform the work: namely, the King and his three ministers. Outside the circle, let there be pentagons in the four angles. In the lower circle, let four Divine names be written, with crosses placed between them.
